name: Strait of Magellan
note: Ferdinand Magellan's 1520 passage that gave it its name.
description: The Strait of Magellan threads the storm-wracked tip of South America between the continent's mainland and the islands of Tierra del Fuego. For four centuries after Ferdinand Magellan's fleet found it in 1520, it was the safest passage between the Atlantic and the Pacific — hazardous in itself, with williwaw winds and tight doglegs, yet gentler than the open ocean south of Cape Horn. The Panama Canal took most of its traffic after 1914, but the strait remains a working seaway and one of the great names in the history of navigation.
